Script.name: tprio core
Script.script:
local function clamp(value, min, max) value = math.min(value, max) value = math.max(value, min) return value end
tprio = tprio or {}
tprio.list = tprio.list or {}
tprio.current = tprio.current or 0
function tprio.add(name) if not table.contains(tprio.list, name) then table.insert(tprio.list, name) end end
function tprio.reset() tprio.current = 0 tprio.list = {} echo("Target priority: none.") end
function tprio.addGroup(list) if type(list) == "string" then tprio.add(list) elseif type(list) == "table" then for _, tg in ipairs(list) do tprio.add(tg:lower():title()) end else error("tprio.addGroup: incorrect input, must be string or table.") end tprio.print() end
function tprio.remove(name) local n = table.index_of(tprio.list, name) if n then table.remove(tprio.list, n) end tprio.print() end
function tprio.string() return "\nPriority Targets: "..table.concat(tprio.list, ", ") end
function tprio.pt() send(f"pt {tprio.string()}") end
function tprio.print() echo(tprio.string()) end
function tprio.next() if (not (tprio.current == 0)) and target then tprio.current = table.index_of(tprio.list, target) or tprio.current end tprio.current = clamp(tprio.current+1, 1, #tprio.list) raiseEvent("tprio", tprio.list[tprio.current]) end
function tprio.previous() if target then tprio.current = table.index_of(tprio.list, target) or tprio.current end tprio.current = clamp(tprio.current-1, 1, #tprio.list) raiseEvent("tprio", tprio.list[tprio.current]) end
function tprio_auto_target() if thammer.players[target] then return end for i, v in ipairs(tprio.list) do if thammer.players[v] then tprio.current = i raiseEvent("tprio", v) break end end end

Script.name: tprio_pt
Script.script: function tprio_pt(e, name) target = name:lower():title() send("st "..target) targetting(target) end
